shared_elements: low-relief carving on a tall upright stone pillar/monolith
schematic figures rendered in shallow relief with plain outlines and no infill detail
motifs stacked vertically down the face of the pillar
curved/ring-like or crescent forms (arms/discs in B, animal bodies in A)
justification: Both surfaces carry shallow, schematic low-relief motifs arranged one above another on the face of a tall upright block, and both favour plain silhouettes without internal detailing. But the subject matter differs entirely: A shows quadrupedal animals in profile with legs and snouts, while B shows an anthropomorphic pillar-figure with a face, headdress-like bands, arms folded on the body and abstract disc/ring motifs — no shared creature, symbol or relationship beyond the generic vertical stacking.
